abilities.name: skill-link
abilities.effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and triple kick to their full length every time.

kanto.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

original-johto.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

hoenn.flavorText: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

updated-johto.flavorText: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.

original-unova.flavorText: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

updated-unova.flavorText: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

kalos.flavorText: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: At night, this Pokémon uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, Shellder closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.

original-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon’s tongue is always hanging out. It uses its tongue with great dexterity to dig up sand from the seabed in its search for food.

updated-alola.flavorText: Even when its shell is closed, its tongue still hangs out. If you give its tongue a good yank, the shock will cause Shellder to open its shell.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

swsh.flavorText: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
